highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.148.0 is the first stable v4 release, built on Skia milestone m148.
highlights_body: It adds variable and color-font support, animated WebP encoding, a reworked singleton lifecycle, and refreshed native dependencies. This is a breaking release for anyone relying on legacy null-typeface behavior — review the changes below before upgrading.

breaking.title: GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo retyped, loses value-equality
breaking.body: GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo is now GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo (was GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo), and the type no longer implements IEquatable<T> or the == / != operators. Update any code that compares two GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo instances with Equals or operators to compare fields directly instead.

breaking.title: SKNativeObject.IgnorePublicDispose is now get-only
breaking.body: The protected IgnorePublicDispose property lost its setter. Derived types that assigned it directly must instead set it through the constructor or another provided mechanism.

breaking.title: SKFont/SKPaint no longer resolve a null typeface lazily
breaking.body: new SKFont().Typeface is now SKTypeface.Empty instead of null, so MeasureText returns 0 until you assign a real typeface; new SKPaint().Typeface is now SKTypeface.Default instead of null. Construct SKFont with an explicit typeface, and use Typeface.IsEmpty instead of a null check to detect "unset".

breaking.title: SKTypeface.FromFamilyName and Default are now never null
breaking.body: FromFamilyName("missing") now returns SKTypeface.Default on every platform, including Android (previously null there), and SKTypeface.Default is guaranteed non-null everywhere. For a strict "was it found?" check, use SKFontManager.Default.MatchFamily(name), which still returns null on no match.

breaking.title: SKStream.Move(long) now throws on overflow and is obsolete
breaking.body: The overload used to silently truncate offsets larger than int.MaxValue; it now throws OverflowException and is marked [Obsolete] (CS0618). Call Move(int) with an in-range, validated offset instead.

bullets.detail: Bundles the Chrome m148 engine, rolling up the m132/m147 upgrades from the preview cycle along with upstream bug-fix merges.
Adds variable font support to SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp, plus color font palette support, with improved variable font robustness.

bullets.lead: Animated WebP and zero-copy stream data
bullets.detail: Adds SKWebpEncoder support for animated WebP encoding and SKStream.GetData() for zero-copy stream-to-data conversion.
Adds SKSamplingOptions support to SKSurface.Draw and SKCanvas.DrawSurface, and a HBColor struct for proper hb_color_t representation.

bullets.lead: Fixed API naming and wrapper gaps
bullets.detail: Adds missing API wrappers and fixes naming convention violations found while auditing the surface.

bullets.lead: Corrected pixel access strides and offsets
bullets.detail: SKPixmap/SKBitmap.GetPixelSpan now uses RowBytes for stride, and the generic GetPixelSpan<T>(x, y) overload uses Height instead of Width when computing its offset.
SKPath no longer crashes when its SKPathBuilder is collected first.

bullets.lead: Restored default-typeface resolution and WinUI packaging
bullets.detail: Moves default-typeface resolution to the managed layer, and fixes the WinUI Projection DLL not being found for .NET 9 consumers.
SKGLView now renders correctly after a MAUI TabBar tab switch, and the Uno gallery sample no longer downgrades the Skottie package.
Reworks how singleton instances are created and torn down, and moves the native-compat gate from a [ModuleInitializer] to the SkiaApi static constructor for more predictable startup.

bullets.lead: Legacy text APIs promoted to compile errors
bullets.detail: Obsolete legacy paint text/font state-reading APIs and the remaining pre-v4 obsoletes are now compile errors, completing the v3-to-v4 API cleanup.
Adds Linux Bionic and Tizen x64/arm64 native build support, and uses PolySharp to enable C# 13 language features on legacy target frameworks.
Updates expat, freetype, zlib, libjpeg-turbo and libpng/libexpat to their latest versions, and updates harfbuzz to 14.2.0.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Variable font support, the singleton lifecycle rework, the SKPath finalizer fix, and the Skia m147 bump.
contributor_summaries.4Darmygeometry: Linux Bionic native asset support and the PolySharp-based C# 13 support for legacy TFMs.
contributor_summaries.ebariche: Contributed a fix included in this release.
contributor_summaries.sasakrsmanovic: Contributed a fix included in this release.
contributor_summaries.SimonvBez: Fixed SKGLView not rendering after a MAUI TabBar tab switch.

preview_summaries.v4.148.0-rc.1.2: Release Candidate 1 finalized the singleton lifecycle rework, the legacy text API removals, and the pixel-span stride/offset fixes ahead of stable.
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.3.1: Preview 3 added variable font support, harfbuzz 14.2.0, and CI/build-chain stabilization across samples, Docker and NanoServer.
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.2.1: Preview 2 landed color font palette support and refreshed native dependencies including freetype and zlib.
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 opened the v4 line with the Skia m147 bump, animated WebP encoding, and SKStream.GetData().

harfbuzz_summary: Updates the bundled HarfBuzz to 14.2.0 and adds variable font shaping support alongside the HBColor struct for hb_color_t representation.
